0.why: Note.cpp Note::process: getChannels() on this jack sets the output channel count and the loop bound, and getVoltage(c) is clamped to -10.f and 10.f and converted at twelve semitones per volt, commit 086d8c4, whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.3.2 and whose res/ matches the installed panels

Note.cpp Note::process: setChannels then setVoltage of the input voltage, rounded to twelfths of a volt while the chromatic switch is on, commit 086d8c4, whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.3.2 and whose res/ matches the installed panels

comment: Rounding uses a step of 0.083333 rather than an exact twelfth, so a quantised pitch is a fraction of a cent flat of true equal temperament at the top of the range. configBypass routes the input to the output when the module is bypassed.
